record.name: Fieldwork
record.topic: A little space for the next big idea

messages.author: Maya Chen
messages.text: Morning, team! The updated direction for our autumn collection is ready for a look. I brought the notes from yesterday into one place.

messages.author: Maya Chen
messages.text: The main change is a calmer opening and more room for the work. Let me know what feels right.

messages.author: Alex Rivera
messages.text: This feels much clearer. I put together a short outline for the review so we can spend more time on the details.

messages.author: Sam Patel
messages.text: A small update from the build: the new navigation is in place. The notes below cover what changed and what to try.

unfurl.title: A new home for the studio
unfurl.text: The latest workspace update: a simpler way to find the conversations and projects that matter.

messages.author: Jamie Park
messages.text: Thanks for bringing this together. I’ll review the opening this morning and leave a few thoughts in the thread.

messages.author: Maya Chen
messages.text: Perfect. We have time to explore both directions before the team review tomorrow.

replies.author: Alex Rivera
replies.text: The extra space around the opening makes such a difference. I’d keep that direction.

replies.author: Sam Patel
replies.text: Agreed. I’ll check how the longer project names sit in the navigation.

replies.author: Jamie Park
replies.text: I added the mobile notes to the review document.
